text:
maria: RC hotpatch candidate (rc-hotpatch-20260320-ht1) ready for promotion, but QA surfaced a small latency regression on long prompts (~3% p99 increase). pinning candidate for now. :eyes:

jake: Thx — can we avoid blocking the entire window? what's the earliest safe canary size?

anand: Suggest telemetry gate first. Need 30m of traffic at 5% to validate. If metrics stable, promote to 25%.

liz: We're in the 22:00 UTC change window. If we hold past +30m we miss DB maintenance slot. Any fast mitigations? :thinking_face:

maria: Options: rollback quantization change (slower, but low-risk) or promote with smaller canary + strict telemetry cutoff. Preference: small canary + auto-rollback trigger.

deploybot: deploybot: Promotion window open 22:00-23:00 UTC. To promote run: `./deploy promote --rc rc-hotpatch-20260320-ht1 --env prod --canary 5`

sheriff-bot: Rollout hold enabled until manual ack from ops-oncall.

ops-oncall: I'll own the telemetry watch. I'll run the collector and the rollback drill during canary. If error-rate delta > 0.8% or avg latency increase > 120ms, we rollback.

jake: Minimal checklist for this promo: 1) pin artifact 2) KV-warm (warm cache) 3) enable telemetry collector 4) canary 5% 5) 30m watch 6) step to 25% if stable.

maria: Pin command (run now):
```bash
./deploy pin --rc rc-hotpatch-20260320-ht1 --reason "QA latency check"
```

anand: Telemetry quickstart (collector runs on ops box):
```bash
ssh ops@watcher
./telemetry-collector --rc rc-hotpatch-20260320-ht1 --duration 30m --metrics "p50,p95,p99,error_rate" --out /tmp/rc-telemetry.json
curl -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d @/tmp/rc-telemetry.json https://telemetry.redwood.internal/eval
```

liz: If we need an immediate mitigation, we can flip model-variant to quantized-v1 which historically shaved 60ms off long tokens. Need ops approval for variant fallback.

ops-oncall: Approved for fallback as emergency mitigation. But prefer canary + telemetry first.

maria: OK executing pin and scheduling the canary at 22:00. I'll call for go/no-go 5m before window.

(22:00) deploybot: Promotion started: canary 5% -> rc-hotpatch-20260320-ht1. KV warm triggered.

ops-oncall: Telemetry collector started. baseline vs canary diff will be posted in 10m increments.

(22:12) deploybot: Canary at 5% healthy. sample metrics: p50 +8ms, p95 +34ms, p99 +120ms, error_rate +0.2%.

jake: Looks within our rollback thresholds so far. keep watching. :thumbsup:

(22:30) ops-oncall: 18m into watch. cumulative: p99 +110ms (slightly down from earlier), error_rate +0.5%. Still under 0.8% abort threshold.

maria: Can we step to 25% now? We need to verify traffic mix.

anand: I recommend 15% intermediate step before 25% given sensitivity. set step duration 15m.

(22:35) deploybot: Promoting canary -> 15% (staged). KV warm in progress.

(22:50) ops-oncall: After 15m at 15%: p99 delta stabilized around +95ms, error_rate +0.6%. No anomalous regressions in chat-tooling flows.

maria: Proceed to 25% per plan.

(22:52) deploybot: Promoting -> 25%.

(23:05) ops-oncall: End of telemetry watch. Final aggregates: p50 +7ms, p95 +28ms, p99 +98ms, error_rate +0.62%. All within acceptance criteria.

maria: Great — promoting to full prod now. deploybot, execute final promotion command and lift pin.

deploybot: Final promotion executed. rc-hotpatch-20260320-ht1 is live at 100% prod. Pin removed. :party_parrot:

liz: Thanks team. Documenting change in release notes and patching rollout notes. I'll open a short postmortem doc for the latency blip and the quantize fallback test.

maria: Good job. We'll schedule a quick rollback drill in next week's oncall to rehearse the quantized fallback path. :hammer:
